+        The buffer this object contains belongs to some other object, so

diff --git a/tests/test_testing.py b/tests/test_testing.py
index 11fe29d..60f20ba 100644
--- a/tests/test_testing.py
+++ b/tests/test_testing.py
@@ -1,3 +1,4 @@
+import gc
 import os
 import sys
 from io import BytesIO
@@ -6,7 +7,9 @@ import pytest
 
 import click
 from click.exceptions import ClickException
+from click.testing import _NamedTextIOWrapper
 from click.testing import CliRunner
+from click.testing import StreamMixer
 
 
 def test_runner():
@@ -469,3 +472,66 @@ def test_isolation_flushes_unflushed_stderr():
 
     result = runner.invoke(cli)
     assert result.stderr == "gyarados gyarados gyarados"
+
+
+def test_named_text_wrapper_close_preserves_shared_buffer():
+    buffer = BytesIO()
+    first = _NamedTextIOWrapper(
+        buffer, encoding="utf-8", name="first", mode="w"
+    )
+    second = _NamedTextIOWrapper(
+        buffer, encoding="utf-8", name="second", mode="w"
+    )
+
+    first.write("first")
+    first.flush()
+    first.close()
+    second.write("second")
+    second.flush()
+    second.close()
+
+    assert not buffer.closed
+    assert buffer.getvalue() == b"firstsecond"
+
+
+def test_stream_mixer_buffers_survive_wrapper_finalization():
+    mixer = StreamMixer()
+    stdout = _NamedTextIOWrapper(
+        mixer.stdout, encoding="utf-8", name="<stdout>", mode="w"
+    )
+    stderr = _NamedTextIOWrapper(
+        mixer.stderr, encoding="utf-8", name="<stderr>", mode="w"
+    )
+    stdout.write("out")
+    stdout.flush()
+    stderr.write("err")
+    stderr.flush()
+
+    del stdout, stderr
+    gc.collect()
+
+    assert not mixer.stdout.closed
+    assert not mixer.stderr.closed
+    assert not mixer.output.closed
+    assert mixer.stdout.getvalue() == b"out"
+    assert mixer.stderr.getvalue() == b"err"
+    assert mixer.output.getvalue() == b"outerr"
+
+
+def test_stream_mixer_buffers_survive_mixer_finalization():
+    mixer = StreamMixer()
+    stdout = mixer.stdout
+    stderr = mixer.stderr
+    output = mixer.output
+    stdout.write(b"out")
+    stderr.write(b"err")
+
+    del mixer
+    gc.collect()
+
+    assert not stdout.closed
+    assert not stderr.closed
+    assert not output.closed
+    assert stdout.getvalue() == b"out"
+    assert stderr.getvalue() == b"err"
+    assert output.getvalue() == b"outerr"
